value.name: Epic
value.description: A big user story that needs to be broken down.

value.name: Story
value.description: Functionality or a feature expressed as a user goal.

value.name: Task
value.description: A small, distinct piece of work.

value.name: Bug
value.description: A problem that impairs or prevents the functions of a product.

value.name: Subtask
value.description: A small piece of work that is part of a larger task.

value.name: Open
value.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

value.name: In Progress
value.description: This issue is being actively worked on at the moment by the assignee.

value.name: Reopened
value.description: This issue was once resolved, but the resolution was deemed incorrect.

value.name: Resolved
value.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter.

value.name: Closed
value.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct.

value.name: High
value.description: Serious problem that could block progress.

value.name: Medium
value.description: Has the potential to affect progress.

value.name: Low
value.description: Minor problem or easily worked around.

value.name: Lowest
value.description: Trivial problem with little or no impact on progress.
